summary: Applied Optoelectronics, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose entry into an Equity Distribution Agreement with Raymond James and Needham, allowing the company to issue and sell up to $600 million of its common stock at-the-market. The agreement is a routine financing facility, not a special-situation event. No shares are sold yet; the company has no obligation to sell and can suspend at any time. Sales agents receive 2% compensation per sale. Terms include reimbursements capped at $10,000 for blue-sky filings and $30,000 upon termination under certain conditions. This is an ordinary capital-raising arrangement, no deal terms apply.
